All 26 tests pass.

**Changes made**

- `app/repositories/tickets.py`
  - `list_for_board(board_id, include_archived=False)` now filters out archived tickets by default, respects `include_archived=True`, and returns items sorted by `(position, id)`.

- `app/services/tickets.py`
  - `list_board_tickets(board_id, include_archived=False)` normalises `board_id` with `int(board_id)` and forwards `include_archived` to the repository.

- `app/web/views.py`
  - Imports `query_flag`, parses `include_archived` from the query with the existing helper, forwards it to the service, and returns `meta` with both `count` and the normalised `include_archived` boolean while keeping the item shape.

- `web/api/tickets.js`
  - `fetchBoardTickets(boardId, { includeArchived = false } = {})` keeps backward compatibility, URL-encodes the board id, and only appends `?include_archived=true` when `includeArchived` is truthy via an `if (includeArchived)` guard.

- `web/hooks/useTickets.js`
  - Owns `includeArchived` state via `useState(false)`, passes it to `fetchBoardTickets`, includes it in the `useCallback` dependency array, and returns `{ tickets, loading, reload, includeArchived, setIncludeArchived }`.

- `web/components/TicketBoard.jsx`
  - Consumes `includeArchived` / `setIncludeArchived` from the hook and renders an accessible controlled checkbox labelled “Show archived” while preserving the Refresh button, loading `aria-busy`, count paragraph and ticket list.

- `templates/board.html`
  - Adds `data-include-archived="false"` to the mount `<main>` element.
